# agentic-account

Set up and track brand social accounts and their connections.

Keywords: accounts,social,setup,registry,agentic-suite,cli,mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-account".
- CLI: agentic-account summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-account mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-account
